rationale: Pulp's installed static SDK now compiles its pinned Brotli and Google woff2 decoder sources directly into pulp-canvas so a product plug-in can register browser-authored WOFF2 fonts without rediscovering or linking a private decoder target. The implementation preserves the existing bundled-font API and validation contract, adds a compressed-input size bound, and remains a Pulp packaging and dependency-integration choice rather than a change to Vellum's canvas semantics or source authority.
